description:
All-in-one ebook reader

Koodo Reader is an all-in-one eBook reader for Windows, macOS, Linux, and the web, supporting over 15 formats.
New Features
- The bookmarks, notes, and highlights lists in the left panel now support searching and sorting by reading progress
- Supports automatic import of books from local folders. Click the triangle next to the “Import” button. Each time the app launches, it will automatically scan the specified folder for new books and import them
- Added the total number of search results to the in-book search feature
- Added highlight rules to text rules, allowing you to highlight specific text within a book
- Improved software security: Sandbox environment and context isolation are enabled by default, and the rendering process’s permissions to access and manipulate the local machine have been disabled. Due to this change, custom TTS plugins will no longer be supported
- Optimized memory usage during book import
- The Translation, Dictionary, Ask AI, and Notes popups can now be moved to any position or pinned to the right side to function as a sidebar
- Support for clearing AI chat history
- Support for configuring HTTP and SOCKS5 proxies; go to Settings > More Settings
- Scanned PDFs now support more annotation styles, including highlighters, text, shapes, and more
- Support for copying AI chat responses; tap the “Copy” button at the bottom of the response
- Optimized the PDF TTS feature to support more natural sentence breaks
- OPDS now supports downloading books in more formats
- (Mobile) Optimized performance and frame rate for smooth and simulated page-turning animations
- (Mobile) Adapted to the iOS 26 Liquid Glass effect
- (Mobile) The iOS version now supports importing folders
- (Mobile) Supports custom app icons; go to Settings > Appearance
- (Mobile) The Android APK version now supports scanning all books on the device
- (Mobile) The Android APK version now supports automatically importing all books from a specified folder
- (Mobile) The app now supports 10 additional languages
- (Mobile) Added highlight rule feature to text rules, allowing you to highlight specific text in books
- (Mobile) Added support for clearing chat history in AI chat
- (Mobile) Optimized the TTS feature for PDFs, supporting more natural sentence breaks
- (Mobile) Optimized error messages for the sync feature
- (Mobile) Optimized the list performance of AI chat; now only the last three rounds of conversations are displayed by default
- (Mobile) Upgraded to the new React Native architecture to improve overall app performance
- (Mobile) Automatically keeps the screen on during synchronization to prevent interruptions caused by the screen locking
Fixes
- Fixed an issue with footnote display in certain books
- Fixed a memory leak when exporting books or backing up the book library
- Fixed an issue where text at the bottom of the screen was obscured when full-text translation and new word definitions were enabled in scroll mode
- Fixed styling issues with tables within books
- Fixed an issue where the right-click menu on a book was obscured by the window edge
- Fixed an issue where certain CBR comics could not be imported
- Fixed an issue where the download progress bar obscured the settings button
- Fixed a blank screen issue when opening a book after deleting a custom TXT parser
- Fixed compatibility issues with custom AI models for certain model providers and models
- Fixed an issue where OPDS could not load more than 20 books
- Expanded the font size adjustment range
- (Mobile) Fixed blurry text when zooming in on PDFs on Android
- (Mobile) Fixed an issue where books in subfolders could not be imported
- (Mobile) Fixed an issue with the display of footnotes in some books
- (Mobile) Fixed a styling issue with tables in books
- (Mobile) Fixed an issue where text at the bottom was obscured in scroll mode after enabling full-text translation and new word definitions
- (Mobile) Fixed an issue where some CBR comics could not be imported
- (Mobile) Fixed compatibility issues with custom AI models for certain model providers and models
- (Mobile) Fixed abnormalities in the audiobook feature under certain conditions
- (Mobile) Fixed styling issues with AI Book Q&A in Dark Mode
- (Mobile) Fixed an issue on iOS where the system menu obscured selected text
- (Mobile) Fixed crashes that occurred in some cases while reading PDFs on iOS
- (Mobile) Fixed an issue where table of contents navigation did not work for some PDF books
- (Mobile) Fixed an issue where verification codes could not be entered on iPad in certain situations
- (Mobile) Fixed an issue where selecting text on iPad would cause the page to turn unintentionally
- (Mobile) Fixed an issue with abnormal download progress when downloading multiple books simultaneously; now limited to downloading only one book at a time
Note
This version has been selected as the stable release candidate. It should work fine in most cases. If you have any concerns, please download the previous stable version
Tip
You can also download the installation package for this version from the our self-hosted mirror.
